name: SEPTRAN DS TABLET 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SEPTRAN DS

SEPTRAN DS TABLET is a combination of Sulphamethoxazole and Trimethoprim, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage lung infections (pneumonia or Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia) caused by a bacteria called Pneumocystis jirovecii and toxoplasmosis (infection with the Toxoplasma gondii parasite).

It can also be used to manage urinary tract infections, respiratory tract infections (such as bronchitis), ear infections (such as otitis media), and an infection called nocardiosis, which can affect the lungs, skin, and brain. SEPTRAN DS TABLET is suitable for use both in adults and in adolescents (aged 12 years or older).

Take SEPTRAN DS TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor, even if you feel better during the middle of the therapy, to achieve better results. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking SEPTRAN DS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, any allergic conditions, genetic disorders, blood-related disorders, folic acid deficiency, high blood potassium levels, or if you are malnourished as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking SEPTRAN DS TABLET are headaches, nausea, diarrhea, high blood potassium levels, fungal infections of the mouth or vagina, and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How SEPTRAN DS Works

SEPTRAN DS TABLET is a powerful antibiotic. It kills the susceptible bacteria by blocking the production of certain essential vitamins (folate) that are necessary for the bacteria to grow, multiply, and survive. Therefore, it destroys the susceptible bacteria and manages their further growth and multiplication within the body, which helps in reducing the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use SEPTRAN DS

Take SEPTRAN DS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow SEPTRAN DS TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. SEPTRAN DS TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection.

Do not stop taking SEPTRAN DS TABLET once your symptom subsides. It is important to take SEPTRAN DS TABLET for the stipulated duration as recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

warnings.details: SEPTRAN DS TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
SEPTRAN DS TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by SEPTRAN DS TABLET.
Avoid consuming alcohol while taking SEPTRAN DS TABLET.

SEPTRAN DS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
SEPTRAN DS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not take SEPTRAN DS TABLET if you are allergic to Sulphamethoxazole, Trimethoprim, sulphonamide medicines (such as gliclazide and glibenclamide) or to thiazide diuretics (such as Bendroflumethiazide).
SEPTRAN DS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
SEPTRAN DS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 12 years). However, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
SEPTRAN DS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

Others

SEPTRAN DS TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Ever had bleeding problems (such as thrombocytopenia)
Have porphyria (a rare blood disorder)

Before taking SEPTRAN DS TABLET, consult your doctor if you:

Have any allergic conditions (such as watery eyes, an itchy nose, or repeated sneezing)
Have anemia or a vitamin B9 (folic acid) deficiency
Have G6PD deficiency (a genetic disorder that affects metabolism)
Have phenylketonuria (the buildup of an amino acid called phenylalanine in the body)
Are underweight or malnourished
Have high blood potassium levels
Have very low RBC, WBC and platelet counts in blood

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking SEPTRAN DS TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines, such as:

Diuretics (medicines used to remove excess water from the body) such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide
Pyrimethamine (a medicine used to manage malaria)
Medicines used for blood thinning (such as warfarin)
Phenytoin (a medicine used to manage epilepsy)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (such as glibenclamide, glipizide, tolbutamide, or repaglinide)
Rifampicin (an antibiotic used to manage tuberculosis)
Medicines used to manage heart problems (such as digoxin or procainamide)
Amantadine (a medicine used to manage Parkinson’s disease)
Medicines used to manage HIV infections (such as zidovudine or lamivudine)
Medicines that can increase the amount of potassium in the blood, such as potassium-sparging diuretics (Ex. spironolactone, acetazolamide), certain steroids (like prednisolone), or ACE inhibitors (Ex. captopril, enalapril, and lisinopril)
Medicines used to suppress immune function and manage graft rejection (such as ciclosporin and azathioprine)
Methotrexate (a medicine used to manage certain cancers or joint pain)
Folinic acid (a type of vitamin B9 supplement)
Contraceptive medicines (birth control pills) Ex. ethinylestradiol, dydrogesterone

Drug-Food Interaction:

SEPTRAN DS TABLET is preferably taken with meals to avoid unwanted stomach problems. However, it can also be taken on an empty stomach. Avoid consuming foods rich in potassium while taking this medicine.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more SEPTRAN DS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and confusion.

introduction:
Introduction About SALPHAZ 500MG TABLET

Salphaz 500mg Tablet contains sulphadiazine, which belongs to the group of medicines called sulphonamides. It is used to manage a wide range of bacterial infections, including food poisoning and meningitis.

Your doctor may carry out blood tests or take urine samples if you are taking SALPHAZ 500MG TABLET for a long time or if you are elderly.

You should drink plenty of fluids while taking SALPHAZ 500MG TABLET, particularly in warm weather. SALPHAZ 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before using it.

SALPHAZ 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver disease or kidney disease. SALPHAZ 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who are suffering from asthma. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Inform your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding before taking SALPHAZ 500MG TABLET.

SALPHAZ 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in babies under one month of age. Consult the child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking SALPHAZ 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Always take Salphaz 500mg Tablet as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water, and do not crush or chew the tablet. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, condition, and body weight.

name: Tabrol DS Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TABROL DS TABLET

TABROL DS TABLET is a combination of Sulphamethoxazole and Trimethoprim which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage lung infections (pneumonia or Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia) caused by a bacteria called Pneumocystis jirovecii and toxoplasmosis (infection with the Toxoplasma gondii parasite).

It can also be used to manage urinary tract infections, respiratory tract infections (such as bronchitis), ear infections (such as otitis media) and an infection called nocardiosis which can affect the lungs, skin and brain. TABROL DS TABLET is suitable for use both in adults and in adolescents (aged 12 years or above).

Take TABROL DS TABLET for the stipulated duration as instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy to achieve better results. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking TABROL DS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, any allergic conditions, genetic disorders, blood-related disorders, folic acid deficiency, high blood potassium levels or if you are malnourished as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking TABROL DS TABLET are headache, nausea, diarrhea, high blood potassium levels, fungal infections of the mouth or vagina and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects troubles you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TABROL DS TABLET Works

TABROL DS TABLET is a powerful antibiotic. It kills the susceptible bacteria by blocking the production of certain essential vitamins (folate) that are necessary for the bacteria to grow, multiply and survive. Therefore, it destroys the susceptible bacteria and manages their further growth and multiplication within the body which helps in reducing the severity of the infection.

How to use TABROL DS TABLET

Take TABROL DS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow TABROL DS TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. TABROL DS TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not stop taking TABROL DS TABLET once your symptom subsides. It is important to take TABROL DS TABLET for the stipulated duration as recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.
